title: Lazar sees Aurora take off at Area 51

tellings.quote: It was a large craft, and it had two huge square exhaust veins, and it sounds more like a rocket than a jet.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in the Nevada desert, tells of watching a test flight near Area 51, a secret US Air Force test base, in 1989. He says he saw a large craft, the one people call Aurora, a rumoured secret aircraft, take off. According to Lazar it had two huge square exhaust vents and sounded more like a rocket than a jet.
